name: Validate Validation Activity
description: Meta-activity that validates whether a validation activity's output changes correctly when implementation changes. Tests that validation logic actually detects changes.

tasks.description: Run baseline validation and capture initial state

variables.name: validation_activity_id
variables.description: ID of the validation activity to test (e.g., 'validate-debugger-integration')

variables.name: target_system
variables.description: Name of the system being validated (e.g., 'debugger-integration')

tasks.description: Make a small implementation change that validation should detect

variables.name: change_type
variables.description: Type of change to make: missing_file, missing_function, missing_test, incomplete_implementation

tasks.description: Re-run validation and capture new state
Verify validation activity correctly detected the change

qualityGates.name: validation_detected_change
qualityGates.description: Validation activity must detect implementation changes

author: AGENT

metadata.purpose: Meta-validation: Ensures validation activities actually detect changes
